import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/output')
from gen import *
from scipy.interpolate import PchipInterpolator
MM=.22186

def top_profile():
 m=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png')).mean(2)<100
 us=np.arange(380,663,dtype=float)
 upper=np.array([np.where(m[:330,int(u)])[0].min() for u in us],float)
 lower=np.array([np.where(m[:330,int(u)])[0].max() for u in us],float)
 mid=(us>=453)&(us<=516)
 lower[mid]=np.interp(us[mid],[452,517],[327,315])
 from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
 upper=gaussian_filter1d(upper,1.5);lower=gaussian_filter1d(lower,1.5)
 return np.c_[us,(upper+lower)/2,(lower-upper+1)]

def trajectory(prof,practice=False,speed=10,offset=.8,wscale=1.):
 xy=prof[:,:2]*MM
 if practice:xy-=np.array([380,257])*MM;xy+=np.array([14,174])
 ss=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xy,axis=0),axis=1))]
 t=np.linspace(0,ss[-1],int(np.ceil(ss[-1]/speed/.05))+1)
 xy=np.c_[np.interp(t,ss,xy[:,0]),np.interp(t,ss,xy[:,1])]
 widths=np.interp(t,ss,prof[:,2])*MM*wscale
 tangent=np.gradient(xy,axis=0);tangent/=np.linalg.norm(tangent,axis=1)[:,None]
 # Cross sections supplied vertical for predominantly horizontal strokes.
 widths*=np.abs(tangent[:,0])
 d=(widths+.65)/1.18
 xy+=tangent*(d*offset)[:,None]
 if practice:
  xyz=np.c_[.0135925-xy[:,1]/1000,-.1359035-xy[:,0]/1000,ZP-d/1000]
 else:xyz=np.c_[.0135925-xy[:,1]/1000,.1135925-xy[:,0]/1000,ZP-d/1000]
 return xyz

def write_xyz(xyz,name):
 move(*xyz[0,:2],.06,2.,name+'_above')
 # approach surface then smoothly enter in motion
 move(*xyz[0,:2],ZP+.001,.7,name+'_approach')
 p=np.vstack([np.r_[xyz[0,:2],ZP+.0002],xyz])
 submit([pose(*v) for v in p],name)
 move(*xyz[-1,:2],.06,.6,name+'_lift')

if __name__=='__main__':
 dip()
 xyz=trajectory(top_profile(),practice=True)
 np.save('/app/output/top_trial_xyz.npy',xyz)
 write_xyz(xyz,'top_trial')
 move(-.10,.149,.09,3.,'clear_trial')
 o=r.get_obs(cameras=['practice_cam']);Image.fromarray(o.last['practice_cam']).save('/app/output/top_trial.png')
PY

import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/output')
from design import *
from scipy.interpolate import PchipInterpolator
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d

def profiles():
 top=np.vstack([top_profile(),[664,277.5,0]])
 # Width values here are cross sections of the exemplar, in image pixels.
 second_edges=np.array([[285,489,490],[290,483,498],[310,479,508],[330,476,511],[350,473,506],[380,468,499],[420,462,491],[450,459,486],[470,456,482],[500,451,478],[530,445,475],[560,439,472],[590,433,470],[620,427,469],[650,423,468],[670,421,468],[690,424,467],[710,434,467],[725,445,465],[733,451,463],[735,457,457]],float)
 u=np.arange(285,736);hi=PchipInterpolator(second_edges[:,0],second_edges[:,1])(u);lo=PchipInterpolator(second_edges[:,0],second_edges[:,2])(u)
 second=np.c_[u,(hi+lo)/2,lo-hi]
 m=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png')).mean(2)<100
 rows=[]
 for y in range(350,731):
  xs=np.where(m[y,:500])[0]
  if y<455:xs=np.where(m[y,440:540])[0]+440
  elif y<490:xs=np.arange(round(np.interp(y,[450,490],[470,465])),round(np.interp(y,[450,490],[507,501]))+1)
  elif y<510:xs=np.arange(round(np.interp(y,[490,510],[465,461])),round(np.interp(y,[490,510],[501,497]))+1)
  elif y>=510:xs=xs[xs>250]
  rows.append([xs.mean(),y,len(xs)])
 left=np.array([[477,311,14],[482,320,43],[490,330,58],[497,340,60]]+rows+[[257,726,0]],float)
 # right: rowwise centres until the foot, then taper horizontally towards its point
 right=[]
 for y in range(500,727):
  xs=np.where(m[y])[0];xs=xs[xs>=max(500,int(500+(y-500)*.4))]
  # rightmost connected run
  parts=np.split(xs,np.where(np.diff(xs)>1)[0]+1);xs=parts[-1]
  right.append([xs.mean(),y,len(xs)])
 right=np.array([[499,477,3],[505,487,16],[510,495,23]]+right+[[738,738,103],[766,742,58],[788,745,24],[802,746,0]],float)
 return [top,second,left,right]

def make_xyz(prof,axis='h',shift=None,speed=10,offset=1.4,wscale=1., start_adjust=0.):
 # Smooth parametric trajectory, with width defined in the same cross-sectional axis.
 xy=prof[:,:2]*MM
 ss=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xy,axis=0),axis=1))]
 t=np.linspace(0,ss[-1],int(np.ceil(ss[-1]/speed/.05))+1)
 xy=np.c_[PchipInterpolator(ss,xy[:,i])(t) for i in []] if False else np.stack([PchipInterpolator(ss,xy[:,i])(t) for i in range(2)],axis=1)
 widths=PchipInterpolator(ss,prof[:,2]*MM)(t)*wscale
 tangent=np.gradient(xy,axis=0);tangent/=np.linalg.norm(tangent,axis=1)[:,None]
 widths*=np.abs(tangent[:,0 if axis=='h' else 1])
 d=(widths+.65)/1.18
 d=np.minimum(d,15.)
 off=offset*d+start_adjust*np.clip(1-t/12,0,1)
 xy+=tangent*off[:,None]
 if shift is not None:xy+=shift
 # preserve one contact until explicit terminal lift
 xyz=np.c_[.0135925-xy[:,1]/1000,(.1135925 if shift is None else -.1359035)-xy[:,0]/1000,ZP-d/1000]
 return xyz
